technical.summary: BAC shows strong bullish technicals with price above all major MAs and positive momentum crossovers, but extreme RSI(9) overbought condition and weak ADX trend strength create elevated pullback risk in a neutral sector environment.

fundamental.summary: BAC shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signal, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and elevated earnings risk within 73 days—insufficient smart money alignment for actionable signal.

sentiment.summary: Weak congressional buying signal from junior members 5+ months ago; market fear (36 VIX equivalent) presents contrarian opportunity but lacks confirming conviction or recent news data.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis regime (336.0) with imminent NFP event creates acute macro stress; normal yield curve provides limited offset; 73-day earnings window mitigates binary risk but does not neutralize current volatility environment.

debate.key_bull_argument: Price above all major moving averages with positive MACD/Hull crossovers and supertrend bullish signal provides technical momentum entry in fear-zone contrarian opportunity.
debate.key_bear_argument: Extreme RSI(9) overbought at 83.24, weak ADX trend strength (17.12), unfavorable macro environment with VIX crisis regime, zero fundamental conviction, and imminent NFP volatility event create unacceptable pullback and drawdown risk.

decision.entry_rationale: Technical momentum is present with price above all major MAs and positive crossovers, but extreme RSI overbought (83.24) combined with weak ADX (17.12) signals imminent pullback risk rather than sustainable entry.
decision.primary_risk: VIX crisis regime (336.0) with imminent NFP event creates acute macro volatility that will likely trigger RSI mean reversion and test support levels, amplifying drawdown risk in already-stressed market.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bear case
decision.portfolio_note: Already 56 positions in Financials sector (18% of portfolio); adding BAC increases concentration risk without fundamental conviction or smart money alignment to justify sector overweight.
